RemediationStrings.Title: Windows security updates are out of date
RemediationStrings.Description: This device is more than 2 monthly Windows security updates behind, or could not be checked. Open Settings > Windows Update, install all available updates and restart. If it still shows as not compliant after 24 hours, contact the Service Desk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Too many months behind on Windows updates
RemediationStrings.Description: This device is more than 2 months behind on Windows security updates. Install all available updates in Settings > Windows Update and restart the device.

RemediationStrings.Title: No Windows update installed recently
RemediationStrings.Description: No Windows update has been installed on this device for more than 100 days. Connect to the corporate network or VPN, install all available updates in Settings > Windows Update and restart.
